chunks: Al-Sadiq, peace be upon him, said:

Whoever looks at the Ka'bah knowingly, and thus recognizes of our right and our sanctity the like of what he recognizes of its right and its sanctity, Allah will forgive all his sins and suffice him the worry of this world and the Hereafter.

key_terms.الْكَعْبَةِ: the Ka'bah, the sacred House of Allah
key_terms.حَقِّنَا: our right, referring to the حق of the Ahl al-Bayt عليهم السلام
key_terms.حَقِّهَا: its right, referring to the right due to the Ka'bah

ai.seo_question: How does recognizing the sanctity of the Ka'bah and the Ahl al-Bayt عليهم السلام affect a believer?
ai.summary: This hadith links recognition of the sanctity of the Ka'bah with recognition of the right and sanctity of the Ahl al-Bayt عليهم السلام. It teaches that such ma'rifah is a cause for complete forgiveness of sins and relief from the burdens of both this world and the Hereafter.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2142 - Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) said:

"Whoever looks at the Kaaba, recognizing its sanctity and our right and sanctity as they recognize its right and its sanctity, then Allah (swt) will forgive all their sins and suffice them in their concerns of this world and the Hereafter."
